notes: Original run FAILED_TECHNICAL on first source prediction, after 30 complete source training epochs and completed same-card profile. Reader was constructed inside inference_mode, creating Sinc tensors without version counters.

The same failure was reproduced locally with a reader accessing a buffer version counter. Prediction now uses no_grad; the regression failed before the fix and passes after. Frozen weights and mathematical forward are unchanged.
Independent P0/P1 review checked no retraining, source checkpoint versus execution commit, original full worker admission inventory/device exclusion, output isolation and prediction-before-truth.
An actual original G and F50 checkpoint two-L_s no-query smoke precedes worker dispatch. The original profile is copied without remeasurement and with its original cost scope.
Both seven-view source and target sets remain fixed and independently scored. Phase3 Tri-SIG-TIME F0/open-set/registration and the six-scene <=3pp target are not yet proven.
